ja.p:
Ja ja-akkharā, In 41-luṃḥso akkharātiu့tvaṅa-byaññaḥ-ācoka phracaso(tāluja)-cavaga tatiya-akkharā. Tipi,8,59+60 ja ja(na) [jana+kvi. Ji+a] 

(1) Body; Body. (Pu) (2) A person who is successful; he. (3) A person who goes fast. Runner. (4) momentum.(5)  Ja sect, sum of /all three alphabers which is in the middle of Garu which come from Chanaḥ book.
